title.zh: 将帕西市Rizal医疗中心床位由三百（300）张增至五百（500）张并为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Increasing the Bed Capacity of Rizal Medical Center in Pasig City From Three Hundred (300) to Five Hundred (500) Beds and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Increasing the Bed Capacity of Rizal Medical Center in Pasig City From Three Hundred (300) to Five Hundred (500) Beds and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật tăng sức chứa giường bệnh của Trung tâm Y tế Rizal tại Thành phố Pasig từ 300 lên 500 giường, và phân bổ kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเพิ่มจำนวนเตียงของศูนย์การแพทย์ Rizal ในเมือง Pasig จาก 300 เป็น 500 เตียง และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang meningkatkan kapasitas tempat tidur Pusat Medis Rizal di Kota Pasig dari 300 menjadi 500 tempat tidur, dan mengalokasikan dana
title.ms: Akta meningkatkan kapasiti katil Pusat Perubatan Rizal di Bandar Pasig daripada 300 kepada 500 katil, serta memperuntukkan dana

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2019/ra_11208_2019.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The authorized bed capacity of the Rizal Medical Center (RMC) in Pasig City is hereby upgraded from three hundred (300) to five hundred (500) beds.

The existing medical equipment and facilities, its operating funds and construction of the needed infrastructure of the RMC are hereby upgraded to conform with and commensurate to the increase in bed capacity as provided in Section 1 hereof.

The increase in bed capacity of RMC from three hundred (300) to five hundred (500) beds shall be implemented for a period of not more than three (3) years from the approval of this Act. The Secretary of Health shall immediately include in the Department’s programs the said implementation, the funding of which shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
